command: set -euo pipefail; APK='/tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-db8c3ce.apk'; PKG='io.blueeye'; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; echo 'DB_BEFORE'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" ls -l databases || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity"; sleep 2; echo 'DB_AFTER'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" ls -l databases; PATH_ON_PHONE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -n1); TMP=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$PATH_ON_PHONE" "$TMP" >/dev/null; HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}'); echo installed_sha256=$HASH; test "$HASH" = '4d4a58789fb94d5e984d2135c2942018f4d8ae0cfb06d6f49692a0a454941ace'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG"; echo ADB_INSTALL_R_PASS
